metric_scope: tracemalloc Python heap during query; excludes SQLite C allocations and process RSS

select_sql:
SELECT agent_response_run.run_id AS agent_response_run_run_id, agent_response_run.user_id AS agent_response_run_user_id, agent_response_run.surface AS agent_response_run_surface, agent_response_run.session_key AS agent_response_run_session_key, agent_response_run.mesh_message_id AS agent_response_run_mesh_message_id, agent_response_run.status AS agent_response_run_status, agent_response_run.checkpoint_json AS agent_response_run_checkpoint_json, agent_response_run.version AS agent_response_run_version, agent_response_run.root_agent_run_id AS agent_response_run_root_agent_run_id, agent_response_run.agent_run_id AS agent_response_run_agent_run_id, agent_response_run.tool_execution_id AS agent_response_run_tool_execution_id, agent_response_run.agent_team_id AS agent_response_run_agent_team_id, agent_response_run.agent_team_task_id AS agent_response_run_agent_team_task_id, agent_response_run.agent_execution_event_id AS agent_response_run_agent_execution_event_id, agent_response_run.id AS agent_response_run_id, agent_response_run.create_time AS agent_response_run_create_time, agent_response_run.update_time AS agent_response_run_update_time 
FROM agent_response_run 
WHERE agent_response_run.user_id = ? AND (agent_response_run.surface, agent_response_run.session_key) IN (VALUES (?, ?)) ORDER BY agent_response_run.id DESC

SELECT agent_response_run.surface AS agent_response_run_surface, agent_response_run.session_key AS agent_response_run_session_key, agent_response_run.run_id AS agent_response_run_run_id, agent_response_run.status AS agent_response_run_status 
FROM agent_response_run JOIN (SELECT max(agent_response_run.id) AS latest_id 
FROM agent_response_run 
WHERE agent_response_run.user_id = ? AND (agent_response_run.surface, agent_response_run.session_key) IN (VALUES (?, ?)) GROUP BY agent_response_run.surface, agent_response_run.session_key) AS anon_1 ON agent_response_run.id = anon_1.latest_id 
WHERE agent_response_run.user_id = ? ORDER BY agent_response_run.id DESC
